name: Flip 7

rounds.endCondition: At least 200 points and a sole leader at the end of a round.

categories.label: Sum of Number cards
categories.hint: Add the values of your Number cards in line (0 is worth nothing). Enter 0 if you busted.

categories.label: x2 card in line
categories.hint: Doubles the Number-card sum only (before adding +modifiers). Adds an extra copy of the sum.

categories.label: +2 to +10 modifier cards
categories.hint: Sum of +2/+4/+6/+8/+10 cards in line; scored even without Number cards. Enter 0 if busted.

categories.label: Flip 7 bonus (7 unique Number cards)
categories.labelVi: Thưởng Flip 7 (7 lá số khác nhau)
categories.hint: +15 if you flipped 7 different Number cards.

tiebreakers.description: If tied for the lead after reaching 200 points, all players play additional rounds until one player leads.
tiebreakers.descriptionVi: Nếu hòa ở mốc 200 điểm trở lên, cả bàn chơi tiếp đến khi có một người dẫn đầu.

notes: family: rounds (press-your-luck; round scores accumulate). Score a player's round: Number sum, x2 first, then add modifiers, then +15 for Flip 7; a busted player scores 0 that round. Enter one scoring per round. At the end of a round with at least 200 points, a sole leader wins. If the lead is tied, all players continue until one player leads.
uiHintReason: Rounds table: one total per player per round.
winConditionVi: Ván kết thúc ở vòng có người đạt 200 điểm; điểm cao nhất thắng.
